The transporter will obtain necessary prior permissions from the concerned departments of the State/Union 
Territory Government for the removal of any objects like hoardings, poles, signboards, transmission line 
shutdown etc. and observe such restrictions as the State/Union Territory Government/National Highway 
Authority of India/NHIDCL may by order specify in this behalf, before the vehicles are put on road. Cost of 
removal and redevelopment of any object permitted by the State/Union Territory Government shall be borne 
by the M/s Bhagyodaya Transport Limited. 


The transporter will give intimation at least ten days in advance and would need to obtain permission before 
commencement of transit, from concerned authority of State or Union Territory Authorities/National 
Highway Authority of India/NHIDCL en-route, in view of the oversized cargo. For each such movement, the 
timing should be prescribed by the concerned authority. 


If so directed by the Public works Department of a State/Union Territory/National Highway Authority of 
India/NHIDCL, the loaded vehicles will not be allowed to pass over or under the bridges on the roads in that 
State/Union Territory and in such cases applicants will have to make arrangements at their cost, after 
obtaining the permission from the concerned Authorities, to cross the rivers/drains. 


The transporter would be liable to pay such amount to the Government of State/Union Territory/National 
Highway Authority of India/NHIDCL or any other affected person where any damage is caused to the roads 
or road structures/bridges/other road users/persons directly or indirectly due to the movement of the trailers. 


Coupling of the trailers along the length of the road will be permissible only for above movements. 
The said vehicles should be moved without any hindrance to the normal flow of traffic. 


The vehicles should display all danger flags and lights, the vehicles should be preceded and followed by a 
vehicle displaying prominently that a heavy load is passing. 


The maximum speed of the trailers for movement on the road shall not exceed 5 km/hr. 


The trailers shall be painted for the entire width by yellow and black zebra stripes on the front and rear sides 
duly marked for night time driving/parking suitably by red lamps at the front and rear and red flags on both 
the sides during day time to indicate the extreme position of the vehicle clearly. 


The transporter will ensure that road taxes have been paid, fitness certificate, insurance cover(including Third 
Party Insurance), National Permit, and PUC have been obtained in respect of all the vehicles to be utilized 
during the above movement. 


No change will be made in the Registration Certificates of the Trailers and Prime Movers as they are already 
registered in the state of Nagaland, Maharashtra, Haryana, Gujarat and Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman 
and Diu. 


In case of issues arising of any vehicle(s) or part of vehicle(s) out sourced from other registered owners, the 
transporter shall bear responsibility for the same. 


Any issue of any nature arising during the transportation of subject consignment shall be the responsibility of 
the transporter. 


The transporter must ensure that the installed VLT Devices (as per AIS-140) are activated during transit of 
the consignment. 


The transporter must ensure that the route does not have overhead structures, RoBs,RuBs, underpasses 
causing vertical constraint to the subject movement or the permission will be excluding the 
RUBs/FOBs/Overpasses for which the transporter shall make diversions for movement of ODC/OWC.

S.O. 4740(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for Land 
Acquisition for Construction of Vellore Bypass from Km47/400-73/250 of NH-234 (New NH 75)Mangalore- 
Villupuram road in the district of VELLORE in the state of TAMIL NADU, hereby declares its intention to acquire 
such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special District Revenue 
Officer,Land Acquisition, National Highways, Vellore in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent 
Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after 
hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, 
by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the 24th August, 2026 


SUBJECT: ASSISTANCE TO NATIONAL SPORTS FEDERATIONS SCHEME - REG. 


F. No. 12-11/2026-Gov-1.— The Government approved the continuation of the Scheme of ‘Assistance to 
National Sports Federations’ (ANSF Scheme) for the period 2026-27 to 2030-31, as the principal mechanism for 
supporting the preparation, training and participation of Indian sportspersons and teams for achieving excellence in 
international competitions. 


2. ANSF is a Central Sector Scheme which provides assistance for training, preparation and participation of selected 
sportspersons, from across the country, for achieving excellence in international events. National Sports Federations 
(NSFs) are required to raise their own resources to finance their operations, and the financial support available under 
the Scheme is supplemental in nature. 


3. The major objectives of the Scheme are: 


i. 


ii.

Vi. 


Vii. 


To support preparation, training and participation of Indian sportspersons and teams in international 
sporting events, in India and abroad, including the Olympic Games, Paralympic Games, Asian Games and 
Commonwealth Games. 


To ensure provision of comprehensive athlete support through NSFs, including training, competition 
exposure, sports science, and other specialised support required for achieving excellence at the 
international level. 


To strengthen professional competence and financial management of NSFs, and to ensure streamlined, 
transparent and timely flow of financial assistance with appropriate accountability. 


To provide financial assistance to NSFs for hosting international sporting events in India, so as to 
strengthen national capacity for conduct of global sports events. 


To support hosting of mega multi-sport events, including the Olympic Games, Asian Games and 
Commonwealth Games, as and when awarded to the country. 


To assist States, IOA and NSFs in conduct of National Games and National Championships, as core 
elements of the domestic competition and talent identification framework. 


To promote grassroots development and capacity building, including development of coaches, technical 
officials and support personnel, to ensure sustainable bench strength across sports disciplines.

Assistance for National Games towards sports equipment, Timing, Scoring and Result (TSR) services, remuneration to 
Technical officials and technical conduct; Allocation of funds for grassroot development; Assistance for hosting of 
international tournaments in India for meeting expenses towards Boarding, lodging & transportation, Rent of playfields, 
Cost of consumable equipment, Certificates, medals and awards, Prize money, Payment of remuneration and travel to 
Technical Officials/Referees/ Umpire/Jury, Hosting / competition sanction fee, Uniform for technical officials/ referees/

the conduct of the international event, Accessibility Audit and Accessible Transportation; Assistance for engagement 
of High Performance Directors, Foreign Coaches, Foreign Experts, National Chief Coach, other Coaches; Assistance to 
NSFs for engagement of support personnel such as sports medicine doctors, physiotherapists, Psychologist etc; 
Assistance for National Camps/Training in Academies; Training of the Elite athletes at the Olympic Training Centres; 
Assistance towards Travel from place of stay to national camp/foreign training/ competition & back; Assistance towards 
boarding & lodging etc. for national camps and non-camp days dietary allowance for focus group athletes; Assistance 
towards Field of play charges for camps / Championships; Assistance towards Sports kit for campers; Assistance 
towards Medical Insurance for campers; Assistance towards air travel for foreign training / competition exposures; 
Assistance towards deputation of referees/ judges/ umpires/Technical officials for competitions abroad; Assistance

control; Purchase of equipment; Assistance for indigenous sports for global outreach; Assistance for Cultural Exchange

5. Proposals of NSFs for training, coaching, participation in international events, hosting of international sports 
events, engagement of coaches and support personnel etc are considered in meetings of the Annual Calendar of Training 


and Competitions (ACTC), chaired by Secretary (Sports). 


6. The Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and the Sports Authority of India (SAT) shall 
be responsible for operationalising the Scheme and for its overall implementation and monitoring. Guidelines for 
implementation of the Scheme of Assistance to NSFs will be issued by the Ministry and communicated to NSFs and 
other concerned stakeholders.

NOTIFICATION 
Jaipur, the 14th August, 2026 


99.0. 4701(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Western Railway, Engineering Department), Notification number, S.O. 2073 (E) dated 13 April, 2026 published in 
Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 23 April, 2026 (hereinafter referred to as 
the said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 
2008) and Railway Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its 
intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, 
maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely "Proposed linear connectivity taking off 
from Khariya Khangar Railway Station to M/s Marwar Cement Limited, Ghorawat, Gati Shakti Model Cargo Terminal, 
Nagaur and Jodhpur districts)")” in district of Nagaur & Jodhpur of the State of Rajasthan; 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely "Rajasthan 
Patrika","Dainik Bhaskar" And “Dainik Navjyoti” dated 05 May, 2026 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the 
said Act; 


And whereas, out of the surveys of the villages mentioned in the schedule annexed with this notification, no 
objection has been received by Competent authority, Sub Divisional officer Merta (District Nagaur) and total five (5) 
objections were received within the stipulated time period by Competent authority, Sub Divisional Officer Pipar City 


(District Jodhpur) and accordingly, the same was disallowed by competent authority. 


And, whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declare that the land 


specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And, further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government herby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto 


shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

कतिपय प्रारूप नियम में, जिसे केंद्रीय सरकार मोटर यान अधिनियम, 1988 (1988 का 59) की धारा 110 द्वारा प्रदत्त 
शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए और संशोधन करने का प्रस्ताव करती है, को इस अधिनियम की धारा 212 की उप-धारा (1) 
के द्वारा यथा आवश्यक इसके द्वारा प्रभावित होने की संभावना वाले सभी व्यक्तियों की जानकारी के लिए प्रकाशित किया 
जाता है; और एतदद्वारा नोटिस दिया जाता है कि प्रारूप नियमों को उस तारीख से तीस दिन की अवधि समाप्त होने के बाद 
विचारार्थ स्वीकार कर लिया जाएगा जिस तारीख से सरकारी राजपत्र में यथा प्रकाशित इस अधिसूचना की प्रतियां जनता 
के लिए उपलब्ध करायी जाती हैं; 

विनिर्दिष्ट अवधि समाप्त होने के पहले उक्त प्रारूप नियमों के संबंध में किसी भी व्यक्ति से प्राप्त होने वाले आक्षेपों 
या सुझावों पर केंद्र सरकार द्वारा विचार किया जाएगा। 


इन प्रारूप नियमों के प्रति आक्षेपों एवं सुझावों, यदि कोई हो, को अपर सचिव (एमवीएल, परिवहन और सड़क 
सुरक्षा), सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय, परिवहन भवन, संसद मार्ग, नई दिल्‍ली-110001 या ईमेल: comments-

2. केंद्रीय मोटर यान नियमावली, 1989 (इसके बाद उक्त नियमों के रूप में उल्लिखित) के नियम 2 में, उप-नियम (यू) के 
स्थान पर निम्नलिखित प्रतिस्थापित किया जाएगा, अर्थात्‌: 


“(यू) 'बैटरी चालित वाहन' से सड़कों पर उपयोग के लिए अनुकूलित और विशेष रूप से एक इलेक्ट्रिक मोटर द्वारा 
चालित कोई वाहन अभिप्रेत है, जिसकी कर्षण (ट्रैक्शन) ऊर्जा की आपूर्ति वाहन में विशेष रूप से संस्थापित बैटरी 
द्वारा की जाती है: 


बशर्ते कि दो पहियों वाले बैटरी चालित वाहन को अधिनियम के प्रयोजनों के लिए मोटर वाहन नहीं माना जाएगा, यदि 
नियम 126 में निर्दिष्ट परीक्षण एजेंसी द्वारा निम्नलिखित सभी शर्तों को सत्यापित और प्रमाणित किया जाता है, अर्थात्‌:- 


(क) वाहन में 0.6 केवी से कम की तीस मिनट की शक्ति वाली इलेक्ट्रिक मोटर लगी है; 
(ख) वाहन की अधिकतम गति 25 किमी/घंटा या समय-समय पर यथासंशोधित के अनुसार कम है; 


(ग) वाहन उपयुक्त ब्रेक और रेट्रो-रिफ्लेक्टिव उपकरणों से सुसज्जित है, अर्थात्‌, सामने की ओर एक सफेद परावर्तक 
और पीछे की ओर एक लाल परावर्तक; 


(घ) एक सहायक इलेक्ट्रिक मोटर से सुसज्जित किसी पैडल-सहायता प्राप्त वाहन के मामले में, उपरोक्त शर्तों के अलावा, 
मोटर की तीस मिनट की शक्ति 0.6 केवी से कम है और मोटर का आउटपुट उत्तरोत्तर कम हो जाता है और अंत में 
25 किमी/घंटा की या समय-समय पर यथासंशोधित के अनुसार की गति तक पहुंचने पर या साइकिल चालक 
पैडल चलाना बंद कर दे, इससे पहले बंद हो (कट) जाता है। 


स्पष्टीकरण.-मोटर की तीस मिनट की शक्ति का वही तात्पर्य होगा जो एआईएस-049 (संशोधन 1) में निर्दिष्ट किया गया है 
और सत्यापन की विधि एआईएस-041 (संशोधन 1), समय-समय पर यथासंशोधित के अनुसार निर्धारित की जाएगी। 
उपरोक्त परंतुक में निर्दिष्ट सभी वाहन समय-समय पर यथा संशोधित एआईएस-049 (संशोधन 1) के अनुलग्रक-क में 
निर्दिष्ट सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं का अनुपालन करेंगे।

G.S.R. 760(E).—The following draft of certain rules further to amend the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 
1989, which the Central Government proposes to make in exercise of the powers conferred by section 110 of the 
Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (59 of 1988), is hereby published as required by sub-section (1) of section 212 of the said 
Act, for information of all persons likely to be affected thereby; and notice is hereby given that the said draft rules will 
be taken into consideration after the expiry of thirty days from the date on which the copies of this notification as 


published in the Gazette of India, are made available to the public; 


The objections or suggestions which may be received from any person in respect of the said draft rules before 


the expiry of the aforesaid period will be considered by the Central Government. 


Objections and suggestions to these draft rules, if any, may be sent to the Additional Secretary 
(MVL, Transport & Road Safety), Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Transport Bhawan, Parliament Street, 


New Delhi-110 001 or on the email: comments-morth @ gov.in; 
Draft Rules 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Central Motor Vehicles ....... Amendment) 


Rules, 2026. 
2) Save as otherwise provided in these rules, they shall come into force on 015 October 2026. 


2. In the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 (hereinafter referred to as the said rules), in rule 2, for sub-rule (u), the 


following shall be substituted, namely: 


"(u) ‘Battery Operated Vehicle’ means a vehicle adapted for use upon roads and powered exclusively by an 


electric motor whose traction energy is supplied exclusively by a traction battery installed in the vehicle: 


Provided that a two-wheeled battery-operated vehicle shall not be deemed to be a motor vehicle for the 
purposes of the Act, if all the following conditions are verified and certified by a testing agency specified in rule 126, 


namely:- 
(a) _ the vehicle is equipped with an electric motor having thirty-minute power of less than 0.6 kW; 
(b) the maximum speed of the vehicle is less than 25 km/h or as amended from time to time; 


(c) the vehicle is fitted with suitable brakes and retro-reflective devices, namely, one white reflector in the front and 


one red reflector at the rear; 


(d) in the case of a pedal-assisted vehicle equipped with an auxiliary electric motor, in addition to the above 


conditions, the thirty-minute power of the motor is less than 0.6 kW and the motor output is progressively

section(1) of section 3C of the said Act.

Khambhalia in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all 
such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, 
by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall

can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th August, 2026 


S.O. 4725(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highway, S.O. 2934(E) Dated 8 June 2026 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part 
II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 
(48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire 
the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening /four-laning, etc.), 
maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No. 135A in the stretch of land from km. 
108.500 to km 139.00 for Widening to 4 lane from km. 108.500 to km 139.000 of NH-135A Pkg-II (Jaunpur— 
Akbarpur section) on Hybrid Annuity Mode in the state of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in "Aaj” and “The Times of 
India” both dated 19 June, 2026 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has not received any objection under Section 3C; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said 
Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

submitted its report to the Central Government;

conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

ट्रांसपोर्टर, यानों को सड़कों पर लाने से पहले, किसी भी वस्तु जैसे stew, पोल, साइनबोर्ड को हटाने के लिए, 
ट्रांसमिशन लाइन बंद कराना इत्यादि के लिए, राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र सरकार के संबंधित विभागों से आवश्यक पूर्व 
अनुमति प्राप्त करेगा और इस तरह के प्रतिबंधों का पालन करेगा जैसा कि राज्य / संघ राज्य क्षेत्र / भारतीय राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना विकास निगम लिमिटेड इस संबंध में आदेश द्वारा विनिर्दिष्ट 
करता है। राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र सरकार द्वारा अनुमत, किसी भी वस्तु को हटाने और पुनर्विकास कराने की लागत 
मैसर्स प्रीमियर ट्रांसपोर्ट लिमिटेड द्वारा वहन की जाएगी। 


ट्रांसपोर्टर बड़े आकार के कार्गो को देखते हुए, ऐसे यानों की प्रत्येक आवाजाही के संबंध में राज्य सरकार/भारतीय 
राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना विकास निगम लिमिटेड द्वारा इस संबंध में निर्दिष्ट

प्राधिकरण या अधिकारी को कम से कम दस दिन पहले सूचना देगा। ऐसे प्रत्येक गमनागमन के लिए संबंधित 
प्राधिकारी द्वारा समय निर्धारित किया जाना चाहिए। 


यदि ऐसा किसी राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र/भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग/ अवसंरचना विकास 
निगम लिमिटेड के लोक निर्माण विभाग द्वारा निर्देशित किया जाता है, तो लदे हुए यानों को उस राज्य/संघ राज्य 
क्षेत्र में सड़कों पर पुलों के ऊपर या नीचे से गुजरने की अनुमति नहीं दी जाएगी और ऐसे मामलों में आवेदकों को 
नदियों/नालों को पार करने के लिए संबंधित प्राधिकारियों से अनुमति प्राप्त करने के बाद, अपने खर्च पर, अपनी 
व्यवस्था स्वयं करनी होगी। 


ट्रांसपोर्टर राज्य / संघ राज्य क्षेत्र / भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण/ राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग एवं अवसंरचना विकास 
निगम लिमिटेड या किसी अन्य प्रभावित व्यक्ति को ऐसी राशि का भुगतान करने के लिए उत्तरदायी होगा जहां 
सड़कों या सड़क संरचनाओं/ पुलों / अन्य सड़क प्रयोक्ताओं/ व्यक्ति को प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से कोई नुकसान 
ट्रेलरों की आवाजाही के कारण होता है। 


सड़क की लंबाई के साथ ट्रेलरों के युग्मन की अनुमति केवल उपरोक्त आवाजाही के लिए होगी। 
उक्त AT का परिवहन, यातायात के सामान्य प्रवाह में बिना किसी बाधा के होना चाहिए। 


यान पर खतरे संबंधी सभी झंडियां और बत्तियां लगी होनी चाहिए, बेहतर यह होगा कि लदे यानों के आगे तथा 
पीछे एक-एक यान स्पष्ट रूप से यह दर्शाता हुआ चले कि भारी लदा हुआ यान गुजर रहा है। 


सड़क पर चलने के लिए ट्रैलरों की अधिकतम गति 5 कि.मी./घंटा से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए। 


ट्रैलरों की संपूर्ण चैड़ाई में अगले एवं पिछले हिस्से पर पीले एवं काले रंग से जेबरा पट्टी बनाई जाएगी और उस पर 
रात्रि के समय चलाने/पार्किग के लिए आगे और पीछे समुचित रूप से लाल बत्ती होनी चाहिए तथा दिन में दोंनों 
ओर लाल झण्डी लगाई जाएगी, जिससे यान की सही-सही स्थिति का स्पष्ट रूप से पता चल सके। 


ट्रांसपोर्टर यह सुनिश्चित करेगा कि उपरोक्त आवाजाही के दौरान उपयोग किए जाने वाले सभी यानों के संबंध में 
रोड टैक्स का भुगतान किया गया है, फिटनेस प्रमाण पत्र, बीमा कवर (तृतीय पक्ष बीमा सहित), राष्ट्रीय परमिट 
और पीयूसी प्राप्त किया गया है। 


ट्रेलरों और प्राइम मूवर्स के पंजीकरण प्रमाणपत्रों में कोई परिवर्तन नहीं किया जाएगा क्‍योंकि वे पहले से ही 
महाराष्ट्र और हरियाणा में पंजीकृत हैं। 

किसी यान (यानों) या अन्य पंजीकृत स्वामियों से प्राप्त यान (यानों) के भाग से उत्पन्न होने वाले मुद्दे की स्थिति में, 
ट्रांसपोर्टर स्वयं उत्तरदायी होगा। 

माल के परिवहन के दौरान उत्पन्न होने वाली किसी भी प्रकृति का कोई भी मुद्दा, ट्रांसपोर्टर की जिम्मेदारी होगी। 


ट्रांसपोर्टर को यह सुनिश्चित करना होगा कि माल के परिवहन के दौरान संस्थापित वीएलटी डिवाइस (एआईएस- 
140 के अनुसार) सक्रिय हों। 


ट्रांसपोर्टर को यह सुनिश्चित करना होगा कि मार्ग में ओवरहेड संरचनाएं, आरओबी, आरयूबी, अंडरपास न हों 
जिससे माल की आवाज ही में ऊर्ध्वाधर बाधा उत्पन्न हो या अनुमति आरयूबी / एफओबी / ओवरपास को छोड़कर 
होगी जिसके लिए आवेदक ओडीसी / ओडब्ल्यूसी की आवाजाही के डायवर्जन करेगा। 


ट्रांसपोर्टर को इस मंत्रालय के दिनांक 27 अक्टूबर, 2025 के पत्र संख्या आरडब्ल्यू/एनएच-35072/01/2010-

The specific route for transportation of two LOX Storage Tank from M/s Inox India Limited Kandla Sez 
Gujarat to M/s Kandla Port Gujarat by road. 


Load restrictions on various roads and bridges stipulated by the Public Works Department/Local 
Authorities/National Highway Authority of India/NHIDCL will be observed and permission of such 
authorities will be obtained before the vehicles are put on the roads. Movement of the trailers will be 
approved and closely monitored by the concerned road authorities in State/Union Territory/National 
Highway Authority of India from safety point of view. 


The transporter will observe such restrictions as the State/Union Territory Government/National Highway 
Authority of India/NHIDCL may by order specify in this behalf. 


The transporter will obtain necessary prior permissions from the concerned departments of the State/Union 
Territory Government for the removal of any objects like hoardings, poles, signboards, transmission line 
shutdown etc. and observe such restrictions as the State/Union Territory Government/National Highway 
Authority of India/NHIDCL may by order specify in this behalf, before the vehicles are put on road. Cost of 
removal and redevelopment of any object permitted by the State/Union Territory Government shall be borne 
by M/s Premier Transport Limited. 


The transporter will give intimation at least ten days in advance and would need to obtain permission before 
commencement of transit, from concerned authority of State or Union Territory Authorities/National 
Highway Authority of India/NHIDCL en-route, in view of the oversized cargo. For each such movement, the 
timing should be prescribed by the concerned authority. 


If so directed by the Public works Department of a State/Union Territory/National Highway Authority of 
India/NHIDCL, the loaded vehicles will not be allowed to pass over or under the bridges on the roads in that 
State/Union Territory and in such cases applicants will have to make arrangements at their cost, after 
obtaining the permission from the concerned Authorities, to cross the rivers/drains. 


The transporter would be liable to pay such amount to the Government of State/Union Territory/National 
Highway Authority of India/NHIDCL or any other affected person where any damage is caused to the roads 
or road structures/bridges/other road users/persons directly or indirectly due to the movement of the trailers. 


Coupling of the trailers along the length of the road will be permissible only for above movements. 
The said vehicles should be moved without any hindrance to the normal flow of traffic. 


The vehicles should display all danger flags and lights, the vehicles should be preceded and followed by a 
vehicle displaying prominently that a heavy load is passing. 


The maximum speed of the trailers for movement on the road shall not exceed 5 km/hr. 


The trailers shall be painted for the entire width by yellow and black zebra stripes on the front and rear sides 
duly marked for night time driving/parking suitably by red lamps at the front and rear and red flags on both 
the sides during day time to indicate the extreme position of the vehicle clearly. 


The transporter will ensure that road taxes have been paid, fitness certificate, insurance cover (including 
Third Party Insurance), National Permit, and PUC have been obtained in respect of all the vehicles to be 
utilized during the above movement. 


No change will be made in the Registration Certificates of the Trailers and Prime Movers as they are already 
registered in the state of Maharashtra and Haryana. 


In case of issues arising of any vehicle(s) or part of vehicle(s) out sourced from other registered owners, the 
transporter shall bear responsibility for the same. 


Any issue of any nature arising during the transportation of subject consignment shall be the responsibility of 
the transporter.

Under clause 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) 


S.O. 4704(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 20A of the Railways Act, 
1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely “Manmad-Jalgaon 
47 Line” in the district of Jalgaon in the State of Maharashtra, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer 
(1) UTPH, Jalgaon in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof, and the Competent Authority shall give the objector 
the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing such objections and after 
making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.
